title: auth.CreateApiKeyRequest
description:
Request to create a new API key.

# Fields

* `expires` - Optional expiration timestamp. If `None`, the key never expires.
* `name` - A user-provided name for identifying the key.
* `description` - Optional description providing additional context.

expires.description: The expiration timestamp for the API key, or `None` for a non-expiring key.

name.description: A user-provided name to identify this API key.

description.description: An optional description providing additional context about the key's purpose.
